application_order: checkout CVA6 at cpu_revision and initialize its HPDcache submodule at source_submodule_revision
run harness/evaluate.sh with the complete submitted hpdcache_victim_sel module

reconstruction.reference_hdl: read rtl/src/hpdcache_victim_sel.sv from HPDcache submodule f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03, which CVA6 revision 6348e9e684678f83b40d0520028513d06b36e7b2 records
reconstruction.test_sources: Use the pinned architectural tests. For a directed test, the evaluator copies the distributed harness/*.S source to <CVA6>/verif/tests/cpu-eval-patches. To reconstruct that source independently, apply its new-file provenance patch in an empty scratch directory and compare the recorded SHA-256; do not apply the provenance patch to either upstream checkout.

grading_note: No exact elapsed-cycle value is required. The directed program must complete with differences confined to timing-register values. A bounded port check enforces victim eligibility in the selected two-way RANDOM write-through configuration, then the standard 38-program architectural suite must pass.
test_materialization: harness/evaluate_parallel.sh copies the assembly files beside the selected test list into <CVA6>/verif/tests/cpu-eval-patches. The directed test patch is a provenance reconstruction record and is not applied before evaluation.
